records.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
records.translation: Ilagay sa lupa upang gumawa ng mga landas o pagandahin ang iyong mga sahig.

records.source: Ahh... the smell of warm bread and sage.
records.translation: Ahh... ang amoy ng mainit na tinapay at yerbang sage.

records.source: Cuts the duration of negative status effects in half.
records.translation: Hinahati sa kalahati ang tagal ng mga negatibong epekto.

records.source: An ancient bottom-feeder with a dwindling population. Females can live up to 150 years.
records.translation: Sinaunang isdang kumakain sa ilalim at kumakaunti na ang bilang. Maaaring mabuhay nang hanggang 150 taon ang mga babae.

records.source: Adds sweetness to pastries and candies. Too much can be unhealthy.
records.translation: Nagdaragdag ng tamis sa mga pastelerya at kendi. Maaaring makasama sa kalusugan ang labis nito.

records.source: An assortment of wild summer seeds.
records.translation: Sari-saring ligaw na binhi mula sa tag-init.

records.source: A tropical bloom that thrives in the humid summer air. Has a sweet, tangy aroma.
records.translation: Tropikal na bulaklak na yumayabong sa mahalumigmig na hangin ng tag-init. Matamis at maasim-asim ang halimuyak.

records.source: A curved yellow squash that is harvested while immature, and still tender.
records.translation: Kurbado at dilaw na kalabasang inaani habang bata at malambot pa.

records.source: Plant in the summer. Takes 6 days to grow, and continues to produce after first harvest.
records.translation: Itanim sa tag-init. Tumatagal ng 6 na araw upang lumaki at patuloy na namumunga matapos ang unang ani.

records.source: A common misconception is that the flower turns so it's always facing the sun.
records.translation: Karaniwang maling paniniwala na umiikot ang bulaklak upang palaging humarap sa araw.

records.source: Plant in summer or fall. Takes 8 days to produce a large sunflower. Yields more seeds at harvest.
records.translation: Itanim sa tag-init o taglagas. Tumatagal ng 8 araw upang magpatubo ng malaking mirasol. Nagbibigay ng mas maraming binhi sa pag-aani.

records.englishResidueReason: Super is a conventional Filipino intensifier and preserves the recognizable fictional species tier.

records.source: A rare, purple variety of sea cucumber.
records.translation: Bihira at lilang uri ng pipino ng dagat.

records.englishResidueReason: Super is a conventional Filipino intensifier and preserves the recognizable item name.

records.preserveReason: Intentional ellipsis shown to the player; there is no linguistic content to translate.

records.englishResidueReason: Burger is the conventional Filipino food loanword.

records.source: A convenient snack for the explorer.
It's by far the sweetest thing you've ever smelled.
records.translation: Ito na ang pinakamatamis na bagay na naamoy mo.

records.source: This starchy root is one of the most ancient crops.
records.translation: Isa sa mga pinakasinaunang pananim ang ugat na hitik sa almirol na ito.

records.source: Plant these in warm weather. Takes 10 days to mature. Grows faster if planted near a body of water.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa mainit na panahon. Tumatagal ng 10 araw upang mahinog. Mas mabilis lumaki kapag itinanim malapit sa anyong-tubig.
